verdict.rationale: Cerebras has a dedicated streaming capability doc stating that the API sends responses back in chunks and displays them incrementally as the model generates them. Its OpenAI API compatibility suggests the standard streaming pattern works as a drop-in, but the evidence does not explicitly name SSE. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the SSE transport and event format, confirmation of token-level chunk granularity, and independent hands-on corroboration of streaming behavior.
